text:
julia_cs: FYI Aurelia Health requested a short-lived APAC-focused config change for a product demo next Tue. They want traffic pinned to ap-southeast-1, IP allowlist on our egress, and a temporary rate-window increase for a 48h window. Renewal check-in in ~5 weeks, demo feeds into exec decision.

julia_cs: From their note: prefer model redwood-compact-1, fallback to redwood-compact-1q. Start 2024-10-01T02:00Z, duration 48h, requested rate_window=600 rpm per key. Provided IPs: 103.5.140.0/22, 103.6.172.0/23. Masked key sk-***9d7. Org: 02H9Z2A3.

noah_se: tagging infra. Quick Q: do they expect any dedicated instances or just routing + RL bump? Also need confirmation whether session affinity required.

julia_cs: No dedicated GPUs requested. They do want session affinity for stateful SDK sessions. I'll DM full key. Renewal risk: medium.

ritvik_sre: We can add a routing policy to prefer ap-southeast-1 and set a 48h TTL on rate_window. Need full API key and exact start timestamp in UTC. We'll add monitoring and an auto-revert. Also suggest adding a fallback region (ap-northeast-1) with lower weight.

elaine_ops: Confirming: if it's only allowlist + routing pin we can do without legal/commercial for peering. If they asked for BGP peering that'd be different. Any direct peering?

julia_cs: They said "egress IP allowlist" only. No BGP.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-5032: "Aurelia APAC pin + 600rpm rate-window (48h)" assigned to ritvik_sre.

ritvik_sre: Plan for INF-5032: 1) route org 02H9Z2A3 to ap-southeast-1 primary; 2) enable session_affinity for their API key; 3) bump rate_window to 600 rpm TTL 48h; 4) add IP allowlist entries; 5) configure fallback to ap-northeast-1 lower weight; 6) attach billing tag and monitoring. ETA 3 hours after full key received.

julia_cs: Please also schedule a 30min enablement run-through at T-24h and add a feedback survey link to follow-up. They prefer weekday mornings APAC.

ritvik_sre: Snippet (masking values):

```
org_id: 02H9Z2A3
api_key_mask: sk-***9d7
rate_window: 600
window_ttl_seconds: 172800  # 48h
routing:
  primary_region: ap-southeast-1
  fallbacks: [ap-northeast-1]
session_affinity: true
allowed_ips: ["103.5.140.0/22", "103.6.172.0/23"]
```

infra-bot: INF-5032 status: in_progress (assigned ritvik_sre)

ritvik_sre: Applied routing pin + rate_window bump at 1748005400. Attached billing tag "cs-temp-apac-aurelia". Monitoring hooks + rollback scheduled.

deploy-bot: config-change: INF-5032 completed by ritvik_sre at 1748005406. Changes: routing.pin(ap-southeast-1), session_affinity=on, rate_window=600 (TTL 48h), fallback ap-northeast-1, IP allowlist added.

julia_cs: Aurelia confirms demo traffic is hitting APAC region. They hit an SDK caching issue where old IPs were cached; cleared local DNS cache and all good. Note for docs: mention DNS cache + TTL when customers whitelist IPs.

noah_se: I'll run a quick post-demo check for token-level latency and any model quality drift due to fallback model. Add to post-demo eval checklist.

ritvik_sre: INF-5032 auto-revert scheduled at 1748178600 (48h TTL). Will keep thread open until post-demo verification complete.

julia_cs: Post-demo feedback: execs happy, asked for a pricing estimate for a small reserved pool. Renewal risk lowered. Thanks team :party-parrot: 

deploy-bot: INF-5032 status: scheduled_revert at 1748178600. "
